resources.string: Get this device ready to share
Let’s set up the permissions AirRelay needs. Each step explains what you are allowing, and you can skip any optional permission.
AirRelay uses the local network to appear on your iPhone, iPad and Mac and receive video and audio. This device can use Wi-Fi or Ethernet.

Android grants these network permissions automatically. Audio capture is requested only when you start a recording and captures this app\'s own playback sound; the microphone, camera and photo library are never read.
Notifications show the connection status while the receiver is ready in the background and let you stop casting.
Without this permission, the receiver still works, but its status notification is hidden.
Open the screen when casting starts
To open AirRelay and show the pairing code when a device connects while AirRelay is in the background, allow “Display over other apps”.
Find AirRelay in system settings and allow access, then return here.
Without this permission, open AirRelay yourself before connecting.
Choose your preferences. Change permissions and startup options later in Settings.

Android automatically grants the system permissions needed to run the receiver in the background, start after boot and keep the screen awake during a connection. Control these features in Startup and Connection settings.
This device could not open the permission screen. Check Settings → Apps → AirRelay.
Requested only when you start a recording, to capture this app\'s own playback sound. The microphone is never read.
